judgment.notes: Componentwise time derivative on ℝ^n×(0,∞), valued in ℝ^m; variables and dependence on u are explicit. H002 guards derivative existence and is a direct input of every using R. No tangency or PDE property is granted.

Second componentwise time derivative depends on D001 with the same open positive-time domain. Its H002 guard supplies existence; all using R nodes directly include H002. No regularity of the existential normality scalar is assumed.

Spatial derivative matrix has n columns in ℝ^m, with first and second coordinate derivatives and derivatives of u_t explicitly defined. Frobenius square equals the stated finite sum by the norm convention. Dependence on D001 and H002 is legitimate and guarded at each R use.

Componentwise Laplacian is the finite sum of the n pure second spatial derivatives, with the original sign convention and domain. D003 and H002 provide the required notation and existence; no wave-map equation is hidden in this definition.

The real density is exactly |u_t|²+Σ_j|∂_ju|² with Euclidean norms/dot products and Lebesgue spatial integration. e_t denotes its time partial derivative; joint smoothness under H002 ensures it exists through ordinary finite differentiation. No support, integrability or derivative formula is postulated by the definition.

The finite real energy integral has the original normalization. Finiteness is explicitly guarded by N002, which exports integrability at every positive time without mentioning E. R003 and R005, the only inferences using E, directly include N002 and H002. Thus this definition neither assumes the target nor creates a circular existence claim.
